original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚大学确认校外聚会后四名学生死亡
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚恩苏卡大学确认，在校外聚会后四名学生死亡，另有六名学生住院治疗。校方宣布停课三天致哀。据称，四名死者是在饮用疑似酒精和毒品物质后死亡，该说法尚未得到独立证实。

location.site: 尼日利亚大学恩苏卡校区校外社区
location.raw_text: University of Nigeria, Nsukka, Enugu State

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚大学恩苏卡校区确认四名学生死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The University of Nigeria, Nsukka, Enugu State, has confirmed the deaths of four students following an off-campus gathering

key_facts.fact: 另有六名参加聚会的学生在不同医院接受治疗
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: six other students who attended the gathering were receiving treatment at different hospitals

key_facts.fact: 校方宣布停课三天，暂停所有社交与学术活动
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Within these three days, all social and academic activities will be suspended in the University

key_facts.fact: 据称四名死者是在饮用疑似酒精和毒品物质后死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The four deceased reportedly died after consuming substances suspected to be alcohol and drugs

uncertainties: 四名死者的具体死因尚未证实，仅称疑似与酒精和毒品有关
目前仅有单一来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
